crossRefs.note: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

people.name: Ahimaaz
people.line: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David

people.name: Azariah
people.line: High priest during Solomon's reign, descendant of Zadok

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Levite in the lineage of Elkanah

translations.web: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
translations.bsb: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,
translations.kjv: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
translations.asv: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
